sn41.9:1.1: tena kho pana samayena acelo kassapo macchikāsaṇḍaṃ anuppatto hoti, cittassa gahapatino purāṇagihīsahāyako.
sn41.9:1.2: assosi kho citto gahapati acelo kira kassapo macchikāsaṇḍaṃ anuppatto amhākaṃ purāṇagihīsahāyoti.
sn41.9:1.3: atha kho cittagahapati yena acelo kassapo tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā acelena kassapena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn41.9:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho citto gahapati acelaṃ kassapaṃ etadavoca:
sn41.9:1.6: tiṃsa mattāni kho me gahapati vassāni pabbajitassāti.
sn41.9:1.7: imehi pana te bhante tiṃsa mattehi vassehi atthi koci uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato phāsuvihāroti?
sn41.9:1.8: imehi kho me gahapati tiṃsa mattehi vassehi natthi koci uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato phāsuvihāro, aññatra naggeyyā ca muṇḍeyyā ca pāvaḷanipphoṭanāya cāti.
sn41.9:1.9: evaṃ vutte citto gahapati acelaṃ kassapaṃ etadavoca:
sn41.9:1.10: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
sn41.9:1.11: dhammassa svākkhātatā yatra hi nāma tiṃsamattehi vassehi na koci uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato bhavissati phāsuvihāro aññatra naggeyyā ca muṇḍeyyā ca pāvaḷanipphoṭanāya cāti.
sn41.9:2.1: tuyhaṃ pana gahapati kīva ciraṃ upāsakattaṃ upagatassāti?
sn41.9:2.2: mayhampi kho bhante tiṃsa mattāni vassāni upāsakattaṃ upagatassāti.
sn41.9:2.3: imehi kho pana te gahapati, tiṃsamattehi vassehi atthi koci uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato phāsuvihāroti?
sn41.9:2.5: ahaṃ hi bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn41.9:2.6: ahaṃ hi bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi. vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn41.9:2.7: ahaṃ hi bhante, yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn41.9:2.8: ahaṃ hi bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn41.9:2.9: sace kho panāhaṃ bhante bhagavato paṭhamataraṃ kālaṃ kareyyaṃ anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evaṃ vyākareyya:
sn41.9:2.10: natthitaṃ saṃyojanaṃ yena saṃyojanena saññutto citto gahapati puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
sn41.9:2.11: evaṃ vutte acelo kassapo cittaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
sn41.9:2.12: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
sn41.9:2.13: dhammassa svākkhātatā, yatra hi nāma gihī odātavasanā evarūpaṃ uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ adhigamissanti phāsuvihāraṃ.
sn41.9:2.14: labheyyāhaṃ gahapati imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
sn41.9:3.1: atha kho citto gahapati acelaṃ kassapaṃ ādāya yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū etadavoca:
sn41.9:3.2: ayaṃ bhante acelo kassapo amhākaṃ purāṇagihisahāyo.
sn41.9:3.5: alattha kho acelo kassapo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
sn41.9:3.6: acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā kassapo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
sn41.9:3.7: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn41.9:3.8: aññataro ca panāyasmā kassapo arahataṃ ahosīti.
